title: The Mathnawi of Jalaluddin Rumi, Vol. 1
author: Rumi (Nicholson ed)
description: The first volume of Rumi's Mathnawi in Reynold A. Nicholson's edition. This foundational Sufi poem interweaves stories and reflection to explore love, the human condition and the path towards spiritual understanding.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). The PDF is a scan; the EPUB is derived from OCR text and its quality is limited—consult the PDF for the faithful page. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.151299).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
